x: Nearly ten minutes were to elapse before our next man, Geoff Pearson, put in an appearance, and his running enabled us to secure third place in the Open Team Race.
In the long relay Geoff Dearman had requested a late leg in the hope he could obtain a sub 46 split. Sure enough he took over in 5th spot and burst into electrifying action.
Geoff Pearson passed away on 10th July, 2007. He was fourth scorer, in 21st position, in our winning National Cross Country team at Leamington Spa in 1946.
